question: In right triangle \(ABC\), \(\angle C=90^\circ\), \(\tan A=3/4\), and the perimeter of triangle \(ABC\) is 36. Find the length of the hypotenuse \(AB\).
solution: Since \(\tan A=3/4\), let \(BC=3k\) and \(AC=4k\). Then \(AB=5k\). The perimeter gives \(12k=36\), so \(k=3\) and \(AB=15\).
